agent.label: FourierMap
agent.reason: The independent Fourier state map has the lowest aggregate leave-one-trajectory-out scored `y` RMSE among the retained families: `0.08581916496554522` in logged `y` units on `data/train.csv`, versus `0.08971175638571534` for the five-parameter rigid dead-zone map and `0.10647703014936342` for the signed-power map. It also has lower full-training free-running coordinate error than the other retained maps. This is a small advantage, not proof of test superiority: it uses more coefficients, and prefix-to-tail validation gives `0.1982659017905261` in logged `y` units, worse than the simpler alternatives. The rigid dead-zone map is retained as the parsimonious fallback. All candidates omit input history and leave substantial switch residuals.
